technique_name: Remove third-person words from the following sentence.
description: I increased the rate of firearm deaths from 10.3 per 100,000 to 12 per 100,000 from 1999 to 2017.
example: Someone or something increased the rate of firearm deaths from 10.3 per 100,000 to 12 per 100,000 from 1999 to 2017.
